title: TRICARE Retired Reserve Recall Paid-Month Credit: Spreading a Settled Change Over the Month
content:
**Schedule note - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Retired Reserve.** The change in the recall paid-month credit is spread over days: where the change credit covers only part of the month, it is spread over the days that credit covers; where the paid adjustment bill covers only part of the month, it is spread over the days that adjustment covers; otherwise it is spread over every day of the month.

- The change for each day is the change divided by the number of days it is spread over.
- The days a change credit or adjustment bill covers are the coverage days it shows on the premium ledger.
- Every day of the month means all the days the monthly bill of that month covers.

*Hypothetical:* a change credit of 387.33 covering 14 of the 31 days of May is spread over 14 days, 27.6664 a day; had it covered all 31 days it would be spread over 31 days.
